thread:
Matt: Observed a P99 regression on mixtral-8b-moex after yesterday's kernel-selector push. Tail latency ~2.5x up. Suspect chain: router logits -> hot expert set -> KV cache churn -> fallback GEMM hotpath.
Anika: which change exactly? commit/rollout time?
Jordan: it was the kernel selector tweak (prefer_fused_gemm when head_dim % 32 == 0). Canary at 2024-12-07T09:05Z, prod roll ~09:10.
Matt: Minimal repro (small prompt that increases MoE fanout):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"mixtral-8b-moex","input":"Explain quantum entanglement in 5 steps","max_new_tokens":512,"temperature":0.9}'
```
Matt: Quick perf delta (same traffic slice, before -> after selector): throughput 820 -> 760 tokens/s, P99 latency 120ms -> 310ms, avg expert calls 2.1 -> 4.9.
Matt: KV metrics: miss-rate 4% -> 18%, eviction rate x2.
perf-bot: sampled flame (hot spots):
```
42% matmul_fused_fast
18% router_topk_selection
12% kv_cache_eviction
8% cuda_memcpy_async
6% fallback_fp32_matmul
```
Jordan: matmul_fused_fast wins when head_dim aligns to 32, but for head_dim=64 with certain seq lengths we hit a non-optimized path causing fallback (~60-95us extra per matmul). That amplifies when many experts are touched.
Anika: router logits got noisier (variance ~3x). top-k picks skewed, producing a hot expert set. Log excerpt: 
```
router.logit_summary mean=0.42 var=0.78 -> mean=0.39 var=2.41
topk.size_hist before: 1:2% 2:17% 4:48% 8+:33% -> now skewed with spikes at 4 and 8
```
Matt: Quick canary mitigation I tried: clamp router logits temperature to 1.8 and cap per-expert in-flight to 48.
Jordan: Canary (12% traffic) numbers: P99 ~160ms, throughput -8%, KV miss down to 7.5%.
perf-bot: observability rule: when fallback_fp32_matmul_rate > 5% P99 climbs non-linearly. Fallback rate jumped 0.8% -> 6.3%.
Anika: Parallel experiments to run: reduce topk to 3 for sequences >256, apply tanh soft-clipping to logits pre-topk, per-expert micro-batching for small requests, and kernel-selector backoff to conservative_gemm for seq>256.
Jordan: Micro-batching could cut memcpy churn / KV fragmentation by grouping updates, but might add head latency. Prototype in runtime (opt-in) scheduled.
Matt: Local ablation: temp-clamp only -> P99 170ms; per-expert cap only -> 200ms; kernel backoff only -> 210ms; all three combined -> 150ms and KV miss ~5%.
perf-bot: profiler -> hot expert distribution:
```
Expert 17: 23% calls, avg_local_kv_pages=14
Expert 3: 12% calls, avg_local_kv_pages=9
Top10 experts combined = 72% of routed tokens
```
Jordan: Also suspecting RoPE scaling drift: recent onboarding changed RoPE alpha 1.0 -> 0.85 for long sequences which can change attention activation patterns and routing. Need to verify attention norm traces.
Matt: I dumped per-head attention norms and saw amplifications around heads 11 and 13 coinciding with router hotset.
Anika: Action items:
- Jordan: implement kernel-selector conservative fallback for seq>256 and emit fallback_fp32_matmul_rate metric (target <1%).
- Matt: extend canary with logits temp clamp + per-expert inflight cap + topk long-seq heuristic and collect unit-cost (tokens/GPU) numbers.
- perf-bot: create alert if KV miss >10% for 5m and ship kafka metric for fallback_fp32_matmul_rate.
- Anika: create triage doc with microbench numbers and a short operator runbook.
Jordan: I'll push a micro-batching prototype (group up to 8 small in-flight per-expert) to see memcpy / KV update impact.
Matt: I've notified #support with the reproducer in case customers hit it; rollback path ready if needed.
deploy-bot: canary updated at 11:42 UTC: applied temp_clamp=1.8, per_expert_inflight_cap=48, topk_heuristic=auto(<=256->3, >256->4) to 12% traffic.
Anika: Reconvene tomorrow with measured cost impact and decide on global rollout vs partial selector revert.
Jordan: PR and perf traces will land on eng-runtime board (PR D#4321). @Matt please upload attention norm dumps.
Matt: attention dump: https://internal.redwood/trace/2247004321/attn-dump.csv :thumbsup:
support: pinged customers with mitigations and asked for any reproductions.
